notes.title: New Entries, Random Events, and Luck Balance Adjustments Released! V2.1.3 Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello, players![/p][p align="start"]This update brings a batch of new entries and random events. Balance adjustments have been made to the Text Luck attribute and related content. We have also fixed some recently reported and predicted issues. Below are the detailed contents of this update:[/p][p align="start"]🎮【New Content】[/p][p align="start"][b]Rune Stone Attribute Expansion[/b]
Rune Stones will now come with elemental attribute effects! For example:[/p][list][*][p]Fire Stone: Grants the Guardian's attacks a Burn effect.
More effects of elemental Rune Stones await your discovery in the game![/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Brand New Upgrade Entries[/b]
Added a batch of practical and fun new entries, mainly of the following types:
① Mark Type: Attacks have a chance to apply abnormal statuses like Burn, Freeze, Poison, etc.
② Blink Type: Chance to trigger a random teleport when taking damage, avoiding danger.
③ Permanent Growth Type: Killing enemies has a chance to increase certain attributes (e.g., Attack, Health, etc.).
④ Gold Type: Dealing damage has a chance to steal gold. Earn while you fight!
⑤ Shop Type:
- Fresh Shop (likely meaning new/refreshed shop inventory) can increase damage.
- Get one free refresh of shop items upon entering.
⑥ Elemental Combo Type:
- Example: When hitting an enemy simultaneously affected by both Spider Poison and Bleed, chance to summon a tree for area attacks![/p][p align="start"][b]New Random Events & Guardian Acquisition[/b]
Added a new batch of random events to enrich the uncertainty during adventures.
Added acquisition methods for the Dessert and Mushroom Guardians in some events, helping everyone unlock their corresponding Little Witches more easily![/p][p align="start"]⚖️【Balance Adjustments】
[b]Luck Attribute Adjustments:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Luck entries will no longer appear in upgrade/strengthening options.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted random events related to Luck.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly optimized (or adjusted) the Little Witches' Luck-related magic abilities to maintain overall balance.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Guardian Strengthening:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ocean-type Guardians[/p][/*][*][p]Panda Guardian[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]🐛【Bug Fixes】[/p][list][*][p]Fixed garbled text display for Guardian names in the shop on Steam Deck devices.[/p][/*][*][p]Unified adjustment of numerical configurations for random events to avoid extreme situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where related entries would still appear when an attribute was already maxed out.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a BUG where two identical options might appear in the entry selection interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a boundary map issue: After accepting the "Cat's Delivery Task," the destination point will no longer spawn outside the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a BUG where the "Restart" function might not work properly under certain circumstances.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where injected values (likely referring to stat boosts from items/skills) were not reflected in real-time on attribute bonuses. All bonuses now take effect immediately.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]📣【Friendly Suggestion】
After this update, it is recommended to restart the client before starting a new game session to ensure all content loads correctly.
If you encounter any issues during gameplay, please provide feedback to us via the community discussion group or the comments section of this announcement![/p][p align="start"]PS: A Chinese player named Lidou recently created some exquisite fan art for the Little Witch Polorbetter. We'd like to share it with everyone![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579256/29ba518918ce2f73b2f27dcd93bcce69ce806ef6.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Official Steam Deck Support and New In-Game Save Feature!v2.1.2
notes.content:
[p]Dear players, hello![/p][p align="start"]The v2.1.2 update is a significant milestone! We’ve brought the long-awaited Steam Deck support and the crucial instant in-game save feature. Additionally, there are numerous optimizations and new shortcut functions designed to provide a smoother and more convenient gaming experience for all players, especially handheld gamers.[/p][p align="start"]🎮 Now Supports Steam Deck!
From now on, you can enjoy [i]Little Witch Survivors[/i] anytime, anywhere![/p][list][*][p]Fixed Home Button Freeze: We focused on fixing a critical issue where pressing the Home button on Steam Deck could cause the game to freeze, ensuring stable performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Control Scheme Optimization: Exclusive optimizations for handheld controls, making controller gameplay more intuitive.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]💾 Major Feature: Instant In-Game Saves
No more worrying about sudden interruptions ruining your perfect run![/p][list][*][p]Save Freely, Continue Seamlessly: Automatically save your progress at any moment during a single game session.[/p][/*][*][p]Note: This save is a temporary single-session save. It will be cleared after a success or failure settlement to allow for a fresh new challenge.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]⚡ Operation and Efficiency Optimizations
We’ve added a series of shortcut keys to make your gameplay even smoother![/p][list][*][p]New Shortcut Support:[/p][list][*][p]Sell Items: Quickly clear your backpack to free up critical slots.[/p][/*][*][p]Consume Items: Instantly use items for boosts to handle intense battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Refresh Shop: Faster searching for your desired guardians.[/p][/*][*][p]Quick Synthesis: One-click transformation into powerful guardians, simplifying the synthesis process.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]General Control Optimizations: Overall improvements for mouse, keyboard, and controller operations.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]🎯 Other Improvements[/p][list][*][p]Active Settlement in Endless Mode: In Endless Mode, when you feel powerful enough, you can actively choose to settle and take rewards, fully controlling your收益节奏 (reward pace).[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]🔮 Future Prospects
This update lays a solid foundation for the game. Next week, we will welcome a content-rich update, including:[/p][list][*][p]More Affixes: Added to the affix library, bringing more diverse Build combinations.[/p][/*][*][p]More Random Events: Coming soon, making every adventure full of unknown surprises![/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Please ensure your game is updated to the latest version for the best experience.[/p]

notes.title: v2.1.0 Hotfix Patch is Now Live
notes.content: [p]Dear players,[/p][p align="start"]To provide a smoother and more stable gaming experience, we have just released a small hotfix patch (v2.1.0).[/p][p align="start"]▍v2.1.0 Update Log[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where using 【Thor's Bow】 could cause frame rate drops and stuttering.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized performance degradation and stuttering that might occur after prolonged AFK farming in 【Endless Mode】, ensuring a more stable combat experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a rare issue where damage statistics or gold displays might show negative values. All numerical statistics have now returned to normal.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]If you encounter any issues after the update, please feel free to provide feedback via the Steam Discussion Board or the comments section of this announcement.[/p][p align="start"]Thank you once again for your support and understanding! We wish you a pleasant gaming experience![/p]

notes.title: 《Little Witch Survivors》v2.0.9 Update Notice
notes.content:
[p]Dear Players,[/p][p align="start"]Hello everyone! We are bringing you the v2.0.9 update, focusing on game experience optimization, interface adjustments, and enhancements to some Guardians. Here are the detailed contents of this update:[/p][p align="start"]🎨 [b]Visual & Interface Optimization[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Improved Graphics:[/b] Visual effects, icons, etc., are now clearer, and the overall visual presentation is more refined.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Font Update:[/b] Now using a non-pixel font, making text display clearer and improving readability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Attribute Interface Improvement:[/b] The Little Witch attribute page in the pause menu now supports auto-scrolling for easier viewing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Guardian Attribute Description Adjustment:[/b] Guardian attribute descriptions have been moved to the top for quicker reference.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]⚖️ [b]Game Balance & Mechanic Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Crit & Dodge Mechanic Optimization:[/b] The HP loss from Critical Hits will no longer trigger Dodge effects, making combat logic clearer.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Guardian Enhancements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Orange-tier Guardians now have more types of growth attributes, enriching development paths.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced the overall strength of underwater animal-type Guardians.[/p][/*][*][p]Nine-Lives Cat, Panda, and Moon Rabbit have received targeted buffs.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Endless Mode Feature:[/b] Added a "Skip Upgrade Options" button. You can now convert all remaining selection chances into damage attributes with one click, making runs smoother![/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]🛠️ [b]Bug Fixes & Experience Optimization[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Synthesis Preview Fix:[/b] Fixed the display error in the synthesis preview for the Annihilation Stone and Orange Guardians.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Text Proofreading:[/b] Fixed some typos and inaccurate descriptions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Operation Optimization:[/b] Added quick return/back functions to some interfaces for smoother operation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance Optimization:[/b] Optimized the lag issue caused by the Thunder God's Bow skill, making combat smoother.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]📢 [b]Future Update Preview[/b]
This week, we will focus on optimizing controller, keyboard, and mouse operations, as well as Steam Deck adaptation and the new player tutorial![/p][p align="start"]Furthermore, we are developing more new content, including new affixes/word entries, new random events, and more interesting gameplay. Stay tuned![/p][p align="start"]Thank you for your continued support and feedback! If you encounter any issues in the game, please feel free to contact us via the Steam Community Discussions or the comments section of this announcement. We wish you a pleasant gaming experience![/p][p align="start"]✨ Sincerely,
The 《Little Witch Survivors》 Development Team[/p]

notes.title: Four New Orange Weapons Arrive! Version 2.0.8 is Officially Live!
notes.content:
[p]Dear Players,[/p][p align="start"]"Little Witch Survivors" version 2.0.8 is now updated! This update not only brings the mysterious \[Eternal Night Theme] Orange Weapons but also includes various optimizations and adjustments to the gameplay experience. Here are the detailed update notes:[/p][p align="start"]🧡 [b]New Content: Eternal Night Theme Orange Weapons[/b]
Four powerful and mysterious new Orange weapons have been added to the game! Log in now to experience their extraordinary charm![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579256/5e0fc6726a1422bc76078840dcb7d776f310c47b.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]⚖️ [b]Gameplay Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Overall Pace Optimization:[/b] The match difficulty curve is smoother, providing a longer and more satisfying mowing-down experience!For example, the Fox Shop has been changed: it respawns exactly at the first minute, and then every one minute and twenty seconds after that.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Control Diminishing Mechanism:[/b] Repeatedly applying the same type of control effect to monsters will gradually reduce its effectiveness (except for knockback effects).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Knockback Limit:[/b] Bosses can no longer be knocked back too far, keeping the combat more focused.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skill and Mechanism Balance:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Minor Nerfs:[/b] God's Eye, Dodge Increasing Max HP, Bats, Enemy Death Summoning Skeletons.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Buffs:[/b] Robot growth difficulty reduced, making development easier![/p][/*][*][p][b]Official response regarding feedback on the single-player roguelike nerfs being "anti-fun": Due to adjustments to mechanics like knockback control and difficulty curve modifications, the overall balance has been fine-tuned. We have slightly nerfed the overpowered Guardians, but overall, they are now more balanced among themselves while maintaining a higher collective strength.[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Summon Cap:[/b] A new summon limit has been added to prevent too many from causing game freezes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Knockback Mechanism Adjustment:[/b] Knockback diminishing effect removed, making high attack frequency Guardians perform more powerfully![/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]🆕 [b]New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Manual Consume Function:[/b] Simply drag a Guardian into the consume slot to actively consume it!No more infusion needed![/p][/*][*][p][b]Secondary Stats Display:[/b] Detailed secondary attributes can now be viewed in the pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sunny-Side-Up Egg Can Be Eaten:[/b] Of course, you can eat sunny-side-up eggs![/p][/*][*][p][b]Quality Color Differentiation:[/b] Guardian names in the hint bar are now displayed in their quality color for easy identification![/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]📉 [b]Difficulty Adjustment[/b]
The overall game difficulty has been reduced, providing a more comfortable experience for both new and advanced players![/p][p align="start"]🐞 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with the Reroll mechanism behaving abnormally.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some non-synthesizable Guardian combinations incorrectly showed a synthesis preview.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]❤️ [b]Acknowledgements[/b]
The continuous growth of "Little Witch Survivors"离不开离不开 is thanks to the support and feedback from every player. We will continue to strive to bring richer content and a better gaming experience![/p][p align="start"]📣 [b]Feedback Channels[/b]
If you encounter any issues in the game or have any suggestions, please feel free to leave a message in the Steam Community or the comments section of this announcement. We will try to reply to every piece of feedback![/p][p align="start"]Thank you for your companionship and passion. We hope you enjoy the game![/p][p align="start"]— The "Little Witch Survivors" Production Team[/p]

notes.title: 《Little Witch Survivors》Update Notice v2.0.7!
notes.content:
[p]Dear Players,[/p][p align="start"]Thank you for your continued support and passion for our game! This update brings a wealth of optimizations and content adjustments, making the gameplay experience smoother and more exhilarating! Here are the detailed update notes:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Workbench Upgrade:[/b] The Workbench now provides a more detailed preview of synthesis results.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Combat Experience Optimization:[/b] Added a secondary confirmation prompt when continuing combat while Guardians are present at the Workbench.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mandrake & Fear Effect Buff:[/b] Mandrakes and the Fear effect have been strengthened.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Consumption Logic Simplified:[/b] Streamlined the trigger logic for consumable Guardians. They are now consumed directly when Mana Charge is full.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Auto-Mute in Background:[/b] The game automatically mutes when switched to the background.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual Upgrade:[/b] Optimized the visual effects of Guardian icons and shop icons.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Damage Statistics Optimization:[/b] Improved the damage statistics display. Very high damage values now use units like K (thousand) and M (million).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Elite/Boss Indicator Enhancement:[/b] Improved the overhead icons for elite monsters and bosses, making them easier to spot in crowds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Increased Invincibility Frames for Little Witch:[/b] Extended the invincibility period after the Little Witch takes damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Auto-Pause Function:[/b] The game automatically pauses when switching to another window during combat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Exclusion Function UI Optimization:[/b] Improved the display of the exclusion function for more intuitive operation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Projectile Pierce Cap:[/b] Added an upper limit to projectile piercing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Achievement Progress Mechanism Adjustment:[/b] The completion method for purchase-related achievements has been changed to acquisition. Guardians dropped during combat now also contribute to the achievement progress![/p][/*][*][p][b]Resolution Settings Optimization:[/b] Improved windowed mode settings. Resolution options higher than the actual screen resolution will no longer appear, and the window will be centered on the screen each time the resolution is changed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Achievement Re-grant Mechanism:[/b] Optimized the Steam achievement re-grant mechanism. If a Steam achievement wasn't triggered promptly due to various reasons (e.g., network issues), it will now be re-granted upon entering the game![/p][/*][*][p][b]Critical Hit Mechanism Revamp:[/b] The crit mechanism has been changed to independently calculate whether each hit is a critical strike, improving the visual experience![/p][/*][*][p][b]Little Train Buff:[/b] The Little Train has been enhanced! It's now safer for the Little Witch to ride the Little Train.[/p][/*][/olist][p align="start"]🎮 [b]Update Tips[/b]
The version has been automatically pushed. Update the game to experience the new content![/p][p align="start"]If you encounter any issues, please feel free to provide feedback via the Steam Community Discussion board or the comments section of this announcement![/p]

notes.title: Little Witch Survivors - Latest Optimization Update Notes (Version 2.0.6)
notes.content: [p]Dear Wizards,[/p][p align="start"]Hello everyone! Thank you for every message you’ve shared on social media, the Steam community, and comment sections. Whether it’s encouragement, criticism, or valuable suggestions, we’ve carefully read and highly valued all your feedback, and we’ve been working hard to incorporate it into the ongoing optimization of the game.[/p][p align="start"]In this update, we’ve made several adjustments and fixes based on the recent concentrated feedback and experience details from players. Here are the specific changes:[/p][p align="start"]🛠️【Optimization Overview】:[/p][p align="start"]✨ System Adjustments:[/p][list][*][p]New "Rune Stone Downgrade Function": Enhanced (starred) Rune Stones can now be used as regular versions in synthesis. After synthesis, 2 regular Rune Stones will be returned.[/p][/*][*][p]Debt Mechanism Adjustment: Interest will no longer be triggered while in debt.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Gold Drops: The amount of gold dropped in the mid-to-late stages of regular matches has been increased to help everyone accumulate resources faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Highest Difficulty Upgrade: We’ve enhanced the numerical values of the highest difficulty mode. Wizards seeking extreme challenges, are you ready for the true test?[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Early-Game Pressure: The strength of monsters in the first minute of all difficulty levels has been universally reduced, giving everyone more time to develop.[/p][/*][*][p]Chest Mechanism Optimization: The health of monster-dropped chests has been reduced, making it easier to open them~[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]👁️ Visual and Experience Improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Eyeball-Type Skill Effects Optimization: Reduced the transparency of special effects, minimizing vision obstruction during battles for a clearer combat experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Sell Function Optimization: Adjusted icons and UI layout to make the function easier to recognize and significantly reduce accidental clicks.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]🐞 Bug Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the display error for the maximum quantity in the Illustrated Handbook.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the display error for the "Sunny-Side Up Egg" triple synthesis recipe (Note: Sunny-Side Up Eggs cannot be further synthesized).[/p][/*][*][p]"Annihilation Stone" will no longer appear in the store.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a secondary confirmation pop-up: Restarting, abandoning a match, or returning to the main menu now requires confirmation again to avoid accidental exits.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]🧙‍♀️【Character Adjustments】:[/p][list][*][p]Anna has received a numerical boost! We hope she’ll have a stronger presence on the battlefield.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]We sincerely thank every player for your patience and continuous support. "Little Witch Survivors" is still in a stage of continuous growth and optimization, and we look forward to your continued companionship as we work together to create a more complete magical world adventure experience![/p][p align="start"]Wishing everyone a joyful adventure in the magical world. If you have any questions or ideas, feel free to share them with us at any time~✨[/p][p align="start"]Finally, a Chinese player has drawn some amazing fan art of certain characters from "Little Witch Survivors," and I’d like to share it with everyone![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579256/7c67323c3cbfcb79eff979d16e55d9dea00d920a.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Full Version Launch! "Little Witch Survivors" is Now Available! 🎉
notes.content: [p]Dear players, hello! We are thrilled to announce that after careful polishing, the full version of our magical roguelike bullet hell shooter—"Little Witch Survivors"—is finally here today! 🎮✨[/p][p]Each little witch possesses unique magical abilities. Combine them with over 150 different Familiars to create ever-changing battle strategies, helping you fight your way through the storm of bullets![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579256/5f7a46c7607d388c454697e1237c9ae9bd195d31.jpg"][/img]✨ Game Features Overview:[/p][p]🧙‍♀️ 20 Unique Little Witches: Each witch has exclusive magical abilities, waiting for you to discover the strongest combinations![/p][p]🛡️ 150 Types of Familiars: From cute to cool, each Familiar has its unique attack style and special evolution path![/p][p]🌍 5 Exquisite Maps: Explore vastly different scenes, each level is full of unknown dangers and surprises![/p][p]⚔️ 6 Difficulty Levels + Endless Mode: Whether you're a novice or a hardcore player, you can find your own challenge![/p][p]💛 Launch Includes Six Orange Weapons (Orange-tier Familiars): Each one features a permanent growth mechanism, giving you limitless satisfaction![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579256/b558e934de7976e9c15dec6cd9d3595d9c34a9cc.png"][/img]🌟 Welcome Feedback, Grow Together! notes.title: v0.1.7 Update Announcement
notes.content: [p]v0.1.7 Update Announcement[/p][p]A new little witch has come to the Magic Academy, and she seems to have dropped a few cherry blossom petals when she passed by. Two new special random events have been added.[/p][p]And the following content has been optimized:[/p][p]① The level description now indicates the difficulty coefficient.[/p][p]② The backpack has a page turning function.[/p][p]③ The plant guardian will release itself when there is no summon.[/p][p]④ The guardian will no longer change position during synthesis.[/p][p]⑤ The special bonus attribute is upgraded and becomes a blue entry.[/p][p]⑥ Automatic blood deduction will be locked to 1. No more death due to blood deduction.[/p][p]⑦ Mouse operation optimization (solve the problem of high return rate mouse frame drop) handle operation optimization (solve the problem of not being able to see where the selection is when entering the store)[/p]
